risks.description: Delay in receiving third‑party payment vendor API credentials and sandbox access, blocking backend integration and threatening the release date
Chosen UI component library may not fully meet WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility requirements, potentially requiring mid‑project replacement
Staging environment instability has blocked QA regression testing for multiple days, delaying testing and quality assurance
Automated KYC document verification rejects valid government IDs due to image compression degrading scan quality, blocking end‑to‑end onboarding
If vendor credential delay is not resolved within five business days, the end‑of‑month release date is at risk of slipping by 1–2 weeks
Payment gateway integration is behind schedule because the vendor has not yet shared updated API credentials, creating a critical path risk
Potential need to replace the UI library mid‑development if accessibility compliance cannot be achieved, impacting scope and quality

delivery_forecast: The project is currently at risk of missing the end‑of‑month release. While the payment gateway credentials have been obtained and backend work is expected to resume, a critical KYC verification defect and prior staging instability have introduced new blockers that threaten the schedule. The risk register now reflects high‑severity issues that could push the release by one to two weeks unless mitigated quickly.
